title: Valeska Hinton expands outdoor learning with new classroom - NewsBreak
text:
By Breanna Rittman ,
44 minutes ago PEORIA, Ill. (WMBD) — Valeska Hinton Early Childhood Education Center is expanding its outdoor learning program with a new classroom with help from PNC Bank.
“Children in this age are so impressionable, and it’s really important for us that they’re able to see alternative styles of learning,” said Brian Ray, regional president for PNC Bank Central Illinois.
Students at Valeska Hinton Early Childhood Education Center got an opportunity to participate in Wednesday’s groundbreaking ceremony.
“In early childhood kids experiment through play,” said Principal Katie Cobb. “They have an opportunity to discover and work together, learn their social-emotional skills with one another.”
This new classroom is made possible with a $70,000 investment from the ‘PNC Grow Up Great Program.’
“This really goes along well with the philosophy of PNC and reinvesting in our communities, particularly in early childhood education,” said Ray. “What we’ve learned is that, particularly since covid, less than half of the children this age are able to be outside in a classroom-type of environment, which really breeds the creativity and imagination and just the ability for them to have a different educational, hands-on experience.”
Students will also have the opportunity for hands-on learning experiences beyond simply changing the classroom setting.
“They will be able to dig into the dirt and discover different things,” said Cobb. “They will be able to create projects with natural pieces such as wood, flowers, trees and kind of discover the arts as well. We have lots of different art exploration so that they can develop and work together.”
